items.text: Brad Sandefur is a sergeant with the Cook County Sheriff’s Office. His campaign says he has worked for the office since 1990, serving as a correctional officer, police officer, tactical officer, investigator, academy instructor, and shift commander. His campaign also says he is a former U.S. Marine and holds a master’s degree in criminal justice with a forensic psychology focus.

items.text: His campaign website lists three top priorities: modifying the SAFE-T Act and pretrial policy to strengthen public-safety safeguards for repeat offenders, expanding mental health and addiction diversion programs as alternatives to incarceration, and strengthening deputy training and operational readiness.
